bannerLead: Give, volunteer, or build a career — every contribution helps a young person become a future leader.
donateBody1: We need seed money to keep building Claudia House — from home remodeling to furnishing. Your gift helps fight youth homelessness and gives young people the guidance to become self-sufficient adults and productive members of society.
donateBody2: Claudia House is a tax-exempt public charity under IRC Section 501(c)(3). Donations are tax-deductible (official IRS approval letter available on request).
fredMeyerImageAlt: Raised garden bed at Claudia House
fredMeyerBody: Link your Rewards Card to Claudia House (code PQ447) and we receive quarterly donations from Fred Meyer — at no cost to you. Just log in to your rewards account, search 'Claudia House,' and link.
volunteerIntro: We're building a pool of drivers, mentors, and professionals who can contribute skills and time to youth learning and development.

volunteerCards.title: Mentor
volunteerCards.body: Be a steady, encouraging presence for a young person.

volunteerCards.title: Drive
volunteerCards.body: Help youth get to school, work, appointments, and outings.

volunteerCards.title: Teach a Skill
volunteerCards.body: Share your professional expertise through workshops.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.body: Client-centered, trauma-informed case management for justice-involved young adults (18–25). Wed–Sun, 8am–5pm, on-site.

jobs.title: Direct Care Staff
jobs.body: Daily supervision supporting independent-living skill development in a trauma-informed residential setting. Fri–Sun.
